title: Spruce line 1 - PLC runbook
bodyMarkdown:
Owner: Antti Rantanen. Backup owner: Mikko Nieminen.
Last full test: September, restore from backup on the bench, all programs loaded and ran.

## Controllers

| Host | What it runs | Spare on shelf | Last backup |
|---|---|---|---|
| spruce-l1-plc-03 | Infeed conveyors | Yes, shelf B4 | 3 weeks ago |
| spruce-l1-plc-04 | Press 1 | Yes, shelf B4 | 3 weeks ago |
| spruce-l1-plc-06 | Press 2 | Shared with plc-04 | 3 weeks ago |
| spruce-l1-plc-07 | Cooling loop | No, order 4 weeks lead | 3 weeks ago |
| spruce-l1-plc-08 | Robot cell interlocks | Yes, shelf B5 | 3 weeks ago |
| spruce-l1-plc-09 | Packing, called Cold Start on the floor | Yes, shelf B5 | 3 weeks ago |
| spruce-l1-plc-10 | Labeling | No | 3 weeks ago |
| spruce-l1-plc-15 | Palletizer A | Yes, shelf B6 | 3 weeks ago |
| spruce-l1-plc-16 | Palletizer B | Shared with plc-15 | 3 weeks ago |
| spruce-l1-plc-17 | Wrapper | No | 3 weeks ago |
| spruce-l1-plc-18 | Outfeed. Blinky because of the status LED | Yes, shelf B6 | 3 weeks ago |

## Restart order
1. Cooling loop first, wait for flow OK on the panel.
2. Presses, then robot cell interlocks.
3. Packing and outfeed last. If Cold Start does not come up, check the profinet cable at the cabinet door, it gets pinched.

## Vendor contact
Siemens support through the service contract, number on the cabinet door. Contract ends in 2027.

title: Pine - kiln restart
bodyMarkdown:
After a power cut the kiln does not restart on its own.

1. Check that pin1plc1 is in RUN.
2. Then pin1plc2, the safety one. It needs the key.
3. Acknowledge on the panel. Twice.

The key is in the drawer under the panel. If it is not, call Pentti.

title: NIS2 - what applies to us
bodyMarkdown:
Plain words summary. Not legal advice. The official text wins: Directive (EU) 2022/2555, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dir/2022/2555/oj

## Are we in scope
Manufacturing of machinery, electrical equipment and some other products is listed in Annex II of the directive. Whether a company is in scope depends on its sector and its size. Medium and large companies in those sectors usually are. Ask legal to confirm for Tervaniemi Works.

## What the directive asks for (Article 21)
Risk management measures, including:
- risk analysis and information system security policies
- incident handling
- business continuity, backups and crisis management
- supply chain security
- security in acquisition, development and maintenance, including vulnerability handling
- ways to check that the measures work
- basic cyber hygiene and training
- cryptography where it makes sense
- human resources security, access control and asset management
- multi-factor authentication where it makes sense

## Reporting significant incidents (Article 23)
- early warning within 24 hours
- incident notification within 72 hours
- final report within one month

## What this means here
Asset management is on the list. We cannot protect machines we do not know we have. That is the reason for the inventory work.
